name: compact-nudge
description: Nudge the user to run /compact once the session context passes a token threshold, with a ready-to-edit /compact command drafted from the conversation. Claude Code only (function hooks); never compacts on its own.

threshold.title: Nudge threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Start nudging once the context window holds at least this many tokens.

step.title: Re-nudge step (tokens)
step.description: After a nudge, wait until the context grows by this many tokens before nudging again.
